term.title: mass fraction

definitions.text: Mass of a constituent divided by the total mass of all constituents in the mixture.
sources: PAC, 1996, 68, 957. 'Glossary of terms in quantities and units in Clinical Chemistry (IUPAC-IFCC Recommendations 1996)' on page 980 (https://doi.org/10.1351/pac199668040957)
